d: Wild bottom of dark and narrow valley, shaded from above by large trees, which come to weave the branches from one hill to another, among which is closed. Licida and Aminta.

A vast countryside at the foot of a mountain, scattered with pastoral huts. A rustic bridge over the river Alfeo, composed of trunks of trees crudely committed. View of the city of Olimpia in afar, interrupted by a few plants, which adorn the plain, but do not overshadow it. Argene in a shepherd's dress weaving garlands. Choir of Nymphs and Shepherds all occupied in pastoral work. And then Aristea with Séguito.
Lycide and Megacle from different parts.
Clitene preceded by Licida, Alcandro, Megacle crowned with olive trees, Choir of Athlete, Guards and People.

Bipartite, formed by the ruins of an ancient racetrack, already covered in much ivy, thorns and other wild plants. Megacle, held by Aminta for one part, and after Aristea, held by Argene for the other: but those do not veggon these.

The exterior aspect of the great temple of Jupiter the Olympics, from which you descend for a long and magnificent staircase divided into several floors. Square before the same with a burning plow in the middle. Bosco around the sacred olive trees silvestri, from where the crowns formed for the winning athletes. Clistene that descends from the temple, preceded by a numerous People, by its Custodians, by Licida in white crowned with flowers, by Alcandro and by the Chorus of Priests, of whom some carry on golden kisses the instruments of sacrifice.
Megacle between the Guards and sayings.
